name: Incarnate Kaiju

duration.value: until the end of your next turn

text:
You briefly conjure a kaiju, a massive, rampaging monster with a unique name and legendary reputation. It rises from its secluded lair to annihilate your foes. The summoned kaiju occupies the space of a Gargantuan creature. When you Cast this Spell, choose one of the kaiju below to summon.
- Agmazar, the Star Titan Speed 100 feet, climb 50 feet; Arrive (void) Channel Void Each foe in a 100-foot emanation takes 16d8 void damage (basic Fortitude save); Depart Gravitic Repulsion Each foe in a 50-foot emanation is pushed 100 feet away unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save.

- Agyra, the Forever Storm Speed 80 feet, fly 200 feet; Arrive (electricity) Breath of a Thousand Storms Agyra shoots two 1,200-foot lines of electricity, one from each of her heads. The lines can't overlap. Each creature along one of the lines takes 6d12 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save. On a failure, the creature is also Slowed 1 for 1 round (for 1 minute on a critical failure); Depart (sonic) Thunderous Blast Each creature within a 100-foot emanation takes 6d10 sonic damage with a basic Reflex save and is also knocked Prone on a failed save.

- Bezravnis, the Inferno Below Speed 100 feet, burrow 100 feet; Arrive (earth) Burrow from the Earth's Heart Bezravnis explodes from the ground where it was summoned, causing all creatures in a 50-foot emanation to take 8d12 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save. This potentially collapses structures with the collapse effect of the Earthquake spell, except there's no chance of falling into a fissure; Depart Web Hurricane Bezravnis departs with a hurricane of webbing. All creatures within a 50-foot emanation must succeed at a Reflex save or take a –20-foot circumstance penalty to their Speeds until they Escape (or are Immobilized until they Escape on a critical failure). The Escape DC is your spell DC.

- Ebeshra, the Winged Razor Speed 75 feet, fly 100 feet; Arrive (teleportation) Planar Draw Each foe in a 100-foot emanation is pulled 50 feet toward the center, unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save. Creatures that fail and reach the center take 10d6 bludgeoning damage; Depart (electricity) Storm Discharge All creatures in a 240-foot line takes 12d8 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save.

- Mogaru, the Final King Speed 100 feet, swim 100 feet; Arrive (auditory, mental) Trance of the King's Melody Mogaru manifests with a burst of the song that summoned him, requiring all foes within 60 feet who can hear him to attempt a Will save, leaving them Stunned 3 on a failure; Depart (fire) Volcanic Breath Mogaru unleashes his scorching breath in a 120-foot cone. Each creature in the area takes 10d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save. On a failure, it also takes 4d6 persistent,fire damage.

- Vorgozen, the Shapeless Feeder Speed 50 feet, climb 50 feet, swim 100 feet; Arrive Pollute Magic Vorgozen's foul presence pollutes magic around her. Each enemy within a 60-foot emanation that's under the effects of a spell must attempt a Fortitude save. On a failure, the creature is Sickened 2. Any of your enemies that Casts a Spell within 60 feet of Vorgozen must attempt a Fortitude save with the same effects unless it's already sickened; Depart (acid) Beam of Purest Vitriol Each creature in a 1200-foot line takes 10d6 acid damage and 10d6 bludgeoning damage with a basic Fortitude save.

- Yarthoon, the Moon Grub Speed 60 feet, burrow 100 feet, fly 100 feet, swim 100 feet; Arrive (cold) Algid Beam Barrage Yarthoon fires countless beams, targeting each of your enemies within 200 feet of it. The beams deal 10d6 cold damage with a basic Reflex save; Depart (cold, water) Frostbite Mist Chilling mist surges out in a 100-foot burst centered on Yarthoon and remains for 1 minute. This mist has the effects of Mist, plus any creature within the area at the end of its turn takes 5d6 cold damage (basic Fortitude save).
